title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Discount Rates across the Wanderlane Portfolio
content:
A tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club carries four discount rates, each expressed as a percentage and each read against a different part of the Wanderlane portfolio: the hotel rate discount on qualifying hotel rate plans, the car rental discount on qualifying car rental rate classes, the package discount on qualifying vacation packages, and the insurance discount on travel protection premiums.

## Rates by tier

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hotel rate discount (per cent) | 0 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 10 |
| Car rental discount (per cent) | 0 | 3 | 5 | 8 | 10 | 12 |
| Package discount (per cent) | 0 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 10 |
| Insurance discount (per cent) | 0 | 0 | 5 | 10 | 15 | 20 |

## Notes on the rates

Wanderlane Blue carries no discount of any of the four kinds: all four stand at 0 per cent.

The four rates do not move together. The insurance discount is the last to begin: it stands at 0 per cent at Wanderlane Silver as well as at Wanderlane Blue, begins at 5 per cent at Wanderlane Gold, and then rises through 10 and 15 per cent to 20 per cent at Wanderlane Ambassador, where it stands at twice the hotel rate discount of the same tier. The car rental discount stands above the hotel rate discount at every tier above Wanderlane Blue, reaching 12 per cent at Wanderlane Ambassador. The hotel rate discount runs 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 per cent from Wanderlane Silver upward, and the package discount 2, 3, 5, 7 and 10 per cent over the same tiers, the two meeting at 2 per cent at Wanderlane Silver and again at 10 per cent at Wanderlane Ambassador.
